name: 代理受取の招待と受取権限の引き継ぎを確認する
prompt:
Target: LH19-0033, the existing 390×284 Japanese invitation component.
References: image 1 is attempt 1 and preserves the exact Japanese strings, three icon meanings and green CTA. Image 2 is the current 390×284 mock and controls the exact vertical row positions, scale and bounds.
Correct only the vertical placement and scale of the existing content. The first attempt's non-white bands start at y34,99,168,228; the target bands start at y16,84,156,224. Do not add a top margin. Place:
- first icon disc x16,y16,40×40; text x72,y24, one line
- second icon disc x16,y84,40×40; text x72,y80,w302,h48, two lines
- third icon disc x16,y156,40×40; text x72,y152,w302,h48, two lines
- CTA x16,y224,w358,h44
Use an exact white 390×284 canvas and render all text/icons at the mock's native scale. Keep the exact strings and wraps: 招待を承認できるのは1人だけです。 / 友人が承認すると、この食品バッグをご自身で受け取ることはできなくなります。 / 必要であれば、友人に招待を返してもらうことができます。 / 受け取りの招待を送る.
Keep the original distinct person-plus, no-pickup hand and return-arrow outlines, their neutral white bordered 40px circles, slate 20px glyphs, Meiryo Regular14/24 body/button typography, and the forest-green gradient CTA. Do not change icon shapes, line wraps, copy, colors or button geometry. No extra cards, margins, header, toolbar, footer or source-screen media.
reviewNotes: Parent approved exact candidate; see private digest-bound approval.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
